items.body: Australian industrial electro acts Snog and Black Lung are both confirmed to make exclusive appearances in Germany in November 2026. Both acts perform at the Fourscher Festival in Erfurt on 7-8 November, alongside Mildreda, Individual Totem, This Morn’ Omina, Heimstatt Yipotash and others. Snog is centred around David Thrussell and known for left-field dancefloor tracks such as “Corporate Slave” and “Cheerful Hypocrisy,” alongside satirical, nihilistic songs like “The Human Germ” and “The Last Days Of Rome.” The group’s catalogue has been released primarily on Metropolis Records and the German labels Ant-Zen and Hymen. Onstage, Snog perform as a trio with a set described as “bizarre electro-Weimar Cabaret with an Industrial Beat.” Black Lung is a Thrussell solo act presenting the harder, darker, more experimental and techno-leaning side of his work. A new Black Lung album, “Ordo Ab Chao,” is due on Ant-Zen in late October 2026. 2026 has also seen Thrussell release “The Call Of Cthulhu”, a collaboration 2LP with Australian experimentalist Shinjuku Thief, on Metropolis Records, and the ritual ambient LP “The Reign Of Dead Matter” on Ant-Zen. About Snog and Black Lung Snog and Black Lung are both projects of Australian musician David Thrussell. Snog performs as a trio and has released a deep catalogue of industrial dance and electro-industrial material across Metropolis Records, Ant-Zen and Hymen, including reissues of remastered 1990s albums. Black Lung is Thrussell’s solo outlet for harder, more experimental and techno-adjacent material, with releases including the “Babel” collaboration with Xavier Morel and the “Armageddon” and “Euthanasia” videos. Thrussell’s 2026 output spans “The Call Of Cthulhu” with Shinjuku Thief and “The Reign Of Dead Matter” on Ant-Zen, with the new Black Lung album “Ordo Ab Chao” due in late October ahead of the Snog and Black Lung shows at Fourscher Festival in Erfurt on 7-8 November.
items._cn_summary: 本文为新闻报道性质，介绍澳大利亚工业电子音乐人David Thrussell旗下两个项目Snog与Black Lung确认参加2026年11月在德国Erfurt举办的Fourscher Festival演出。文章概述了两个项目的定位差异：Snog作为三人组合，以怪诞的电子-魏玛cabaret风格融合工业节拍著称，曲目偏向左翼舞池方向并带有讽刺虚无色彩；Black Lung则是Thrussell的个人项目，风格更黑暗、实验性更强，偏向techno领域。文中提及Thrussell在2026年发行了多张作品，包括与Shinjuku Thief合作的The Call Of Cthulhu（2LP）、氛围专辑The Reign Of Dead Matter，以及即将由Ant-Zen厂牌发行的Black Lung新专辑Ordo Ab Chao。内容以演出信息和新作预告为主，缺乏对音乐本身的深度评析。

items.body: Lords Of Acid release “Ich Will Nur Das” (I Just Want) on Metropolis Records on 11 September 2026, the group’s fourth single of the year. The frenetic dance track features a vocal by US electronic musician Mari Kattman, sung entirely in German. Ich Will Nur Das by Lords Of Acid Lords Of Acid founder Praga Khan describes the track as “basically a love song with a serious identity crisis. The verses are pure lust: hot, dirty, aggressive and completely unapologetic. Then the chorus suddenly turns into the romantic fantasy of a lovestruck teenager dreaming about eternal love.” Kattman is a Metropolis Records labelmate and a non-German speaker who has been touring on her own recent solo album, “Year Of The Katt.” “She was perfect for this song, as it is incredibly charming to hear her American voice attack these German lyrics,” Khan said. “We didn’t want her pronunciation to be too polished or perfect, as her accent gives the track extra personality. She also understood the contradiction at the heart of the song: one minute she sounds like she wants to devour you, the next she’s dreaming about everlasting love. It’s filthy and innocent at the same time, which is pretty much Lords Of Acid in a nutshell.” “Ich Will Nur Das” follows the previously released “Karaoke Superstar” featuring Princess Superstar, “Dream Boy” featuring Carla Harvey, and “El Mundo Esta Loco” featuring Tony & The Kiki. All four songs appear on “Mundo Bizarro,” the group’s new album, which streams digitally from 15 October to coincide with part two of the “Cheeky Freaky” US tour, with LP and CD editions following on 6 November. “Mundo Bizarro” tracklist: “Dream Boy,” “Dancing On The Flames,” “El Mundo Esta Loco,” “Dopamine War,” “Maximo Roboto,” “Ich Will Nur Das,” “City Of Angels,” “So Stoned Today,” “Karaoke Superstar,” “You’re Obscene” and “A Viking’s Heart.” About Lords Of Acid Lords Of Acid formed in Antwerp, Belgium in 1988 around Praga Khan and are recognised as one of the most influential acts to emerge from the hard-edged electronic dance music scene of that era, blending techno, acid house and industrial music with lyrics on sexuality, drug use and hedonism. The group debuted with the New Beat single “I Sit On Acid,” and its debut album “Lust” appeared in 1991, followed by further releases that saw the band become a staple of the Billboard dance and alternative charts. Carla Harvey, formerly of Butcher Babies, joined as singer in 2025. Having built a global following across a multi-decade touring career, Lords Of Acid remain one of the genre’s most recognisable names, with “Ich Will Nur Das” arriving ahead of the group’s next album, “Mundo Bizarro,” streaming digitally from 15 October 2026 ahead of LP and CD editions on 6 November.

items._cn_summary: 本文介绍比利时老牌电子乐队 Lords Of Acid 即将发行的德语单曲，曲目由美国电子音乐人 Mari Kattman 演唱。乐队创始人 Praga Khan 将其描述为一首带有身份危机的情歌：主歌充满欲望与攻击性，副歌则转向少女式的浪漫幻想。非德语母语者的口音被刻意保留，成为歌曲个性的一部分。乐队风格融合铁克诺、酸性浩室与工业电子，歌词历来围绕情欲与享乐主义展开。此曲收录于新专辑 Mundo Bizarro，将配合美国巡演同步发行数位版本，随后推出 CD 与黑胶实体。整体属于有明确风格的商业电子舞曲制作，但缺乏显著的实验突破或声音设计上的创新。

items.body: Black Lotus, the project of artist Thai, is releasing a concept EP titled “In a Room Full of Dreams” through dark synthwave, dark synth-pop, darkwave and related electronic sounds built around synesthesia, dreams, memory and perception. The title track arrives on 14 September 2026. A streaming link for the title track itself was not confirmed at the time of writing. The EP follows the earlier single “Dreams of Snakes“, already available on Spotify, and includes the tracks “When Sound Becomes Colour” and “Synthesia” alongside the title track. Geert Coppens joins Black Lotus on ‘Dreams of Snakes’ Belgian musician Geert Coppens performs as a vocal duo with Thai on “Dreams of Snakes” and has also contributed to the EP’s visual and video work. Coppens’ back-catalogue reaches into Belgium’s early minimal wave, darkwave and coldwave scenes. About Black Lotus and Geert Coppens Geert Coppens is a Belgian musician who co-founded the Micrart Group with classmate Peter Bonne in 1977, and the two went on to form the new wave band Autumn, active from 1980 to 1984. In 1982, while still working within Autumn, Coppens and Bonne began Twilight Ritual as a side project exploring a darker, more minimal sound; the pair kept Twilight Ritual a two-person project until their paths split in 1985, when Bonne went on to form A Split Second with Marc Ickx while Coppens continued designing artwork for that project and kept working under the Micrart banner. Autumn material was later compiled by Minimal Wave Records on the “Synthesize” collection, and Twilight Ritual has since been reissued on Genetic Music, Onderstroom Records and Wave Records, whose 2021 compilation “1982-2021” gathered 34 tracks spanning the project’s full history. Coppens has also worked more recently under the name Das Cabinett and, in 2023, teamed with Miami-based artist Nina Belief on the EP “In Memory Of” as Faceless 50. His appearance on “Dreams of Snakes” extends that history of collaboration into Black Lotus’s “In a Room Full of Dreams”. Black Lotus is the project of artist Thai, working across music, dance, photography, video, installation and performance-based visual art. “In a Room Full of Dreams” continues that multidisciplinary approach, pairing the EP’s concept around synesthesia and altered perception with Coppens’ contributions to both the music and the accompanying visuals.

items.body: New Jersey industrial project Elektrikill, led by musician and producer Steve Vil, has released “Macabre Masquerade” through Evol Music Group. The 13-track album, Elektrikill’s second full-length of 2026, came out on September 1 and is built around a Halloween theme that runs through the whole tracklist. Macabre Masquerade by Elektrikill “Macabre Masquerade” combines new songs with reworked Elektrikill material, interludes and remixes credited to Kill Vector, Kontrol Phreak and an act billed as SPKTR. Kill Vector reworks “Ravenous” into “Ravenous (Rave Noose Mix),” Kontrol Phreak turns the “Monsters” track “(This Side Of) Parasite” into “Parasite (Darkest Fear Mix by Kontrol Phreak),” and SPKTR remixes “Drugs and Candy” as “Drugs and Candy (Trick Mixxx by SPKTR).” It has not been possible to confirm whether this SPKTR is the same act as The SPKtR, the project Graeme Revell of SPK leads with his son Robert J. Revell, or a separate, unrelated artist using a similar name. Across the album, Elektrikill moves between EBM, darkwave atmosphere, industrial-rock, electronic dance rhythms and cinematic horror, sequencing the tracks as one continuous set rather than a straight collection of horror-themed songs. “Macabre Masquerade” is out on CD and digital platforms, including Bandcamp and Spotify, with a vinyl LP edition available through elasticStage. About Elektrikill Elektrikill is the solo industrial project of Steve Vil, based in Alpha, New Jersey, and formed in 2021. Vil also works as a composer for film and television, with credits including “Grace and the Storm,” “Coma,” “The Pizza Man,” “No Clowning Around” and the theme music for the horror anthology series “Horror Shop Radio.” Elektrikill’s debut album, “Monsters”, arrived in 2023 and was named Industrial Album of the Year by NOTTHEAMP magazine. The project followed it with the EP “Propaganarchy!” (2024), the “Museum of Atrocity” EP (2026) and a contribution, “Titan of Will,” to the compilation “Electronic Saviors 7.” Elektrikill’s third album, “Küntzpiracy”, came out in May 2026 through Evol Music Group. With “Macabre Masquerade,” Elektrikill extends that catalog into a dedicated Halloween release built from new and reworked material.
items._cn_summary: 新泽西工业项目Elektrikill由音乐人兼制作人Steve Vil主导，2026年9月1日通过Evol Music Group发行第二张全长专辑《Macabre Masquerade》，围绕万圣节主题构建。整张唱片以连续混音的形式串联十三首作品，涵盖新歌与旧作重制，交织EBM律动、暗潮氛围、工业摇滚质感、电子舞曲节奏与电影化的恐怖段落。三位remix艺人Kill Vector、Kontrol Phreak与SPKTR分别对曲目进行再加工，将原有素材推向更黑暗的工业变异方向。专辑以CD与数字形式发行，黑胶版本经由elasticStage发行。Elektrikill作为Steve Vil的个人工业计划，其早期专辑曾获NOTTHEAMP杂志年度工业专辑称号，此张万圣节主题作品延续其跨类型工业实验脉络。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — If you have followed my reviews spanning the prog folk diaspora, you'll know there is nothing I welcome less than another version of "Scarborough Fair", with which particularly Nordic groups seem disproportionately enamored. It therefore follows that I cannot recommend an album in which arguably the best track is in this single-song sub genre. Sadly this is the case for the extinct-on-arrival dinosaur known now as the "Kaarmesormus". It might garner 3 stars from a new group just based on the continued mellotron blasts but not from esteemed veterans like KOSMOS, and, while each number could be a supporting cast on a better album, this isn't that. From the soporific first half to the plodding and equally exhausted faux metal second half with its SSRI-free spoken interludes, this is all a big downer, and I do normally appreciate the authentically morose. If I had to pick a couple they would be the opener and "Kielletyn hedelm�n tarha", but both are essentially submerged in their surroundings. Like a therapist once said to a friend who cried incessantly through the first few sessions, "you need a good drug". Start anywhere else and let this one slither off to the side until you are emotionally ready. 2.5 stars rounded down.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自北欧的前卫民谣专辑，由资深乐队 KOSMOS 推出，但评论者对其评价相当消极。整张专辑被批评缺乏新意，尤其前半部分昏昏欲睡、后半部分则沉溺于虚假的金属段落搭配无趣的口白桥段。评论者认为即便是专辑中较出色的开场曲与《Kielletyn hedelmän tarha》，也被周围平庸的曲目所淹没。整张作品最突出的问题是缺乏情绪与能量的变化，被形容为一条已经灭绝的恐龙。评论者建议需要先调整好情绪状态再尝试聆听，最终给出 2.5 星的评价。作为前卫民谣类型，它在跨领域融合方面几乎没有触及实验或电子元素，与用户偏好的实验、前卫、世界音乐方向有交集但表现乏力。

items.body: Dusken Harmony, the dark synthpop and twilight electronics project of Minsk-based multi-instrumentalist Anton Yeroma, releases its new album “Unkeyed” on September 16, 2026, as a nine-track digital release on Bandcamp. Unkeyed by Dusken Harmony ‘Unkeyed’ tracklist and concept “Unkeyed” runs across nine tracks: “The Golden Weight”, “In the Walls”, “Another Face”, “The Sculptor’s Flaw”, “Open the Box”, “The Little Prince of the Night”, “The Secret Flower”, “Lighthouse” and “The Locked Room”. Dusken Harmony describes the album as sitting at the crossroads of dark synthpop and twilight electronics, built on haunting vintage textures, and as a story of artificial isolation, toxic attachments and the search for a flicker of inner light in a world of polished facades. The album is available as a digital release on Bandcamp, with a full links hub at band.link/unkeyed. About Dusken Harmony Dusken Harmony is a musical project run by Anton Yeroma, a multi-instrumentalist based in Minsk, Belarus, blending new wave, post-punk, darkwave and dark synthpop elements. The project’s Bandcamp catalog began with the EP “Disarmed”, released August 14, 2024, a six-track collection paired with the music video for “The Shadow”. “Thorny Agony” followed on May 20, 2025, a nine-track album that included a video for “Black Mask”. “Unkeyed” is the fifth release in Dusken Harmony’s Bandcamp catalog, following “Disarmed” and “Thorny Agony” as well as two further releases, “Shrouded in Mystery” and “The Last Star”. The new album extends the project’s dark synthpop and twilight electronics sound into a concept built around isolation and the search for light within it.

items._cn_summary: 白俄罗斯明斯克音乐人Anton Yeroma以Dusken Harmony之名发行第三张全长专辑，收录九首作品。该项目将黑暗合成器流行与暮色电子结合，借鉴new wave、后朋克与暗潮元素，以复古音色质感为基础构建整体氛围。专辑围绕人工孤立、有毒依恋及在精致表象中寻找微光的概念展开，曲目命名带有文学性与隐喻色彩，如《雕塑家的瑕疵》《夜的王子》《密室》等。从乐队此前EP《Disarmed》与专辑《Thorny Agony》的脉络来看，本作延续了项目对暗黑电子质感的探索。本次发布为Bandcamp数字发行，属独立地下渠道，但文章本身为新闻通稿性质，缺乏对音乐实质的批评性分析。

items.excerpt: French post-industrial project Dernière Volonté releases its new album, “Cendre”, on 25 September 2026, in digipak CD, black vinyl and a limited edition of 250 copies on translucent crystal-blue vinyl. “Cendre” returns to the dense, nocturnal and melancholic atmosphere of Dernière Volonté’s earliest work, revisiting the industrial and dark ambient tone the project carried before its shift toward song-based writing on “Les Blessures de l’Ombre” in 2
items.body: French post-industrial project Dernière Volonté releases its new album, “Cendre”, on 25 September 2026, in digipak CD, black vinyl and a limited edition of 250 copies on translucent crystal-blue vinyl. “Cendre” returns to the dense, nocturnal and melancholic atmosphere of Dernière Volonté’s earliest work, revisiting the industrial and dark ambient tone the project carried before its shift toward song-based writing on “Les Blessures de l’Ombre” in 2003 and “Devant le Miroir” in 2006. The twelve tracks are “Harmonies”, “Vanités”, “Maudits”, “Mandoline”, “L’Âne et le Roi”, “Ombres”, “Des Questions”, “Contre Jour”, “Les Jets de Pierres”, “Plus j’y pense”, “Les Jardins de Tannhäuser” and “Célébration (bien à toi)”. The crystal-blue vinyl edition comes with a printed innersleeve and a download code, while the CD edition ships in a 16-page booklet. “L’Âne et le Roi” is the second track shared ahead of the album, following “Célébration (à toi…)”. Both tracks carry forward the martial rhythms, electronics and voice that have defined the project’s sound since the 1990s, applied here to the darker, sparer arrangements of Dernière Volonté’s formative albums. Dernière Volonté’s extended back catalogue remains available alongside the new album, including “Cristal”, “Commémoration”, “Devant le Miroir”, “Frontière”, “Immortel”, “Le Feu Sacré”, “Mon Meilleur Ennemi”, “Ne Te Retourne Pas” and “Prie pour Moi”. About Dernière Volonté Dernière Volonté is the project of French musician Geoffroy Delacroix, known publicly as Geoffroy D., formed in the mid-1990s. The project’s debut release, “Obéir et Mourir”, arrived in 1998 as a limited cassette rooted in martial industrial and dark ambient, built on militaristic rhythms, historical samples and sparse vocals. “Le Feu Sacré” followed in 2001, still within that early industrial and dark ambient mode. Dernière Volonté’s sound changed direction with “Les Blessures de l’Ombre” in 2003, which applied the project’s martial rhythms to verse-chorus song structures and pop melodies for the first time. “Devant le Miroir” continued that shift in 2006, combining drums, synthesizers and dark textures with more intimate melodies. Geoffroy Delacroix expanded his output in 2008 with Position Parallèle, an electronic side project with Pierre Pi mixing EBM and minimal wave, which has released five studio albums to date including “Néons Blancs” (2013), “En Garde à Vue” (2017) and “Aiguille à Découdre” (2024). Dernière Volonté’s own discography continued with “Immortel” (2010), “Mon Meilleur Ennemi” (2012), “Prie pour Moi” (2016), “Frontière” (2019) and “Cristal” (2022). With “Cendre”, the project returns to the darker, more atmospheric register of its first records while keeping the melodic voice it built up over three decades.

items.body: Swiss electronic musician Carlos Perón and German industrial project Melting Rust Opera released their debut full-length collaboration, “Ultra Haunted Overdrive”, on 7 August 2026 through Dark Daze Music. The ten-track album follows two prior joint singles, “Start Again” and “I’m a Ghost”, and gathers a further eight tracks the pair produced over roughly a year of work. Perón produced the album’s tracks, while Melting Rust Opera’s Stefan Bahners handles vocals and lyrics throughout. “Ultra Haunted Overdrive” runs just under 43 minutes and opens with “Quick and Dirty”, followed by “I’m a Ghost”, “An Other Crime”, “Get the Night Out of Your Head”, “Clean Up”, “It’s Not OK”, “The Disasters We Face”, “I Will Adore You”, “Start Again” and the closing “One Star”. The record brings an industrial rock sound that mixes aggressive guitar structures with electronic production and noise elements, moving between brutal and melancholic registers across its ten tracks. The two singles carried over from earlier releases were both already covered on Side-Line: “I’m a Ghost” appeared as a standalone single on 10 December 2025, and “Start Again”, produced by Perón with vocals and lyrics from Bahners, opened the collaboration on 2 May 2025. A third advance track, “An Other Crime”, followed as a single on 13 March 2026 before landing on the album. Carlos Perón and Melting Rust Opera’s collaboration history Perón and Melting Rust Opera had already worked together before their first joint single. Perón contributed to “Manipuliert – Carlos Peròn Trümmer Mischung” on Melting Rust Opera’s 2023 EP “Neue Trümmer”, and mastered the band’s 2024 album “The Power Of I Don’t Care”, also released on Dark Daze Music. “Ultra Haunted Overdrive” is the first release credited jointly to both acts as a full-length collaboration. About Carlos Perón Carlos Perón is a Swiss electronic musician from Zurich, one of the three founding members of the legendary Swiss synth-pop trio Yello, formed with Boris Blank and Dieter Meier in 1979. He left the group in 1983 to pursue a solo career spanning electronic experiments, film soundtracks and conceptual releases on labels including Ralph Records, Dark Daze Music and SPV. Early solo works include “Impersonator” (1981) and the soundtrack “Die Schwarze Spinne” (1983), followed by a series of conceptual releases through the 1990s and 2000s. Perón founded the Eisenberg label in the late 1980s and launched the “Der Eisenberg Sampler” compilation series, later revived with Norwegian label Sub Culture Records. He also works as a producer and mastering engineer, having worked with acts including Punch ‘n’ Judy and Piston Damp, and with Beborn Beton in Switzerland and Cologne. Through 2025 and into 2026, Perón has released a run of metal-leaning singles under his Dark Daze Music imprint, alongside his ongoing work with Melting Rust Opera. About Melting Rust Opera Melting Rust Opera is an experimental industrial and metal project based in Rheinbach, Germany, centered on musician and producer Stefan Bahners, with Wilson May contributing live percussion. The project emerged in late 2016 or early 2017 after Bahners’ earlier project, Die Rostigen Löffel, went on hiatus, and combines industrial, avant-garde and noise elements with rock and metal structures. Melting Rust Opera’s discography includes the full-lengths “The Rise and Fall of Flesh Wire” (2021) and “different places” (2022), the EP “Neue Trümmer” and the release “Broken Zukunft” in 2023, and “The Power Of I Don’t Care” (2024). The project has also released remix work, including a version of Laibach’s “Bossanova” (2017), two remixes for Dagobert’s single “Das Mädchen aus der schönen Welt”, a remix of Anne Clark’s “Orange Suns” for “Synaesthesia – Classics Reworked”, and a remix of A Place To Bury Strangers’ “I’m Hurt” for “See Through You: Rerealized”. “Ultra Haunted Overdrive” extends the project’s ongoing work with Perón into its first joint album.
items._cn_summary: Carlos Perón 与德国工业项目 Melting Rust Opera 首张合作专辑《Ultra Haunted Overdrive》由 Dark Daze Music 于2026年8月发行，收录十首曲目，总时长约43分钟。Perón 负责全部音乐制作，Melting Rust Opera 主脑 Stefan Bahners 担任人声与歌词创作。专辑将侵略性的吉他结构与电子制作、噪音元素相混合，在暴烈与忧郁之间切换。两位艺术家此前已有合作基础，Perón 曾为 Melting Rust Opera 2024年专辑《The Power Of I Don't Care》担任母带处理。Perón 作为瑞士电子音乐人，曾是传奇合成器流行三人组 Yello 的创始成员之一，1983年离队后转向实验电子、电影配乐与概念性发行。专辑混合了工业摇滚的粗粝质感与电子声响的层次，对关注暗潮与工业电子领域的听众具有一定吸引力。

items.body: New Zealand electronic rock band Robots In Love will release “Cease and Desist” on September 25, the second single from their upcoming album OVERRIDE. The Dunedin-based act is the creative partnership of vocalist and producer Elenor Rayner and drummer and producer Alex Burchell, joined again by guitarist Henry Flynn Wall of Rebirth To Ruin, who also featured on their previous single, “Convergence”. “Cease and Desist” is a melodic industrial track about extreme obsession. Rayner said she recently discovered the word “limerence” and began thinking about the inability to control obsession, which led to the line “limerence closes every door“, describing a state where no amount of reasoning can get through. Musically, the track scales back its verses before building into a chorus built on heavier riffs. The single also carries two remixes. Melbourne cyberpunk act Sirus contributes a version that moves through decades of electronic music, opening with an ’80s-style sound, passing through a ’90s R&B-inspired interlude and closing on darker, more futuristic production. Burchell also remixes the track under his own alias, Magnetique, in a more subversive take. “Cease and Desist” follows “Convergence”, released on June 8, 2026 as the lead single from OVERRIDE. “Convergence” has drawn over 41,000 YouTube views and 14,000 Spotify streams, and Robots In Love have paired “Cease and Desist” with an official video as well. About Robots In Love Robots In Love is the New Zealand electronic rock project of vocalist and producer Elenor Rayner and drummer and producer Alex Burchell, based in Dunedin (Ōtepoti). The current lineup came together in 2023, with Rayner and Burchell also working separately on other projects: Rayner has released material as Sobriquet and The Crystalline Effect, while Burchell drums with Angels Unchained and the Dunedin Symphony Orchestra and produces under the name Magnetique. The band mixes industrial rock, dark electro, drum and bass, trip hop, goth, metal and cyberpunk influences into a sound built on layered vocals, heavy guitars and electronic production. Side-Line has followed the band’s release history since 2022, when Robots In Love, then working as a New Zealand-based dark electro act, teamed up with Swedish producer JA/VI. They premiered the “Gossip In Your Head” video in September 2023, followed by an EP and remix video that November. In April 2024, the band premiered the “Unbreakable” video, and in January 2025 followed with the “Crush” video. Robots In Love released their debut album, “Activate!”, on May 23, 2025, reaching number 17 on the Aotearoa chart. “Convergence” arrived in June 2026 as the first single from OVERRIDE, with “Cease and Desist” now set to follow it on September 25.

items.body: Dead Can Dance, the British-Australian neoclassical darkwave duo formed in Melbourne, released “Into the Labyrinth” on 13 September 1993 through 4AD. The album turns 33 this year. It was their sixth studio album, the first they recorded without any guest musicians, and the first to get a major-label release in the United States, through 4AD’s distribution deal with Warner Bros. Records. It went on to sell more than 500,000 copies worldwide and made the duo 4AD’s highest-selling act. Recording ‘Into the Labyrinth’ at Quivvy Church Lisa Gerrard and Brendan Perry had separated domestically in 1989. Perry was living in County Cavan, Ireland, Gerrard in Australia, and the two wrote their material apart. Gerrard then travelled to Perry’s studio, a converted church at Quivvy, where they merged the songs and recorded the album across three months. Perry engineered and produced it there. Every instrument on the record is played by the two of them, including bongos, sitar and tabla. Gerrard sings in English on tracks 2 to 4, 8 and 11, and uses her wordless vocal technique on tracks 1, 5 to 7, 9 and 10. Tracks 3 and 10 were performed a cappella. Two of the eleven tracks are not the duo’s own writing. “The Wind That Shakes the Barley” is a late 18th-century Irish ballad with words and music by Robert Dwyer Joyce, arranged by the band. Gerrard explained in the album’s press kit why she wanted to record it: “it was meant to be a rallying song, but it has such an intense sadness that it becomes an anti-war song”. The closing “How Fortunate the Man With None” sets four stanzas of Bertolt Brecht’s 1928 poem “Die Ballade von den Prominenten”, in John Willett’s English translation, to music Perry wrote for a Temenos Academy production of the play. It was only the second time the Brecht estate had granted such permission, the first being in 1963. Perry described “The Ubiquitous Mr Lovegrove”, the album’s single, as his alter ego, “the abstract relationship of myself and woman”. The title comes from a 1965 episode of the TV series “Danger Man”. 4AD assembled a video for “Yulunga (Spirit Dance)” using footage from the film “Baraka”. The eleven tracks run “Yulunga (Spirit Dance)”, “The Ubiquitous Mr Lovegrove”, “The Wind That Shakes the Barley”, “The Carnival Is Over”, “Ariadne”, “Saldek”, “Towards the Within”, “Tell Me About the Forest (You Once Called Home)”, “The Spider’s Stratagem”, “Emmeleia” and “How Fortunate the Man With None”. In the UK the CD arrived alongside a limited double vinyl LP that added “Bird” and “Spirit”, the two bonus tracks from the 1991 compilation “A Passage in Time”. Touhami Ennadre supplied the cover photograph, “Hands of the World”; Chris Bigg designed the sleeve with Perry, and Ken Kavanagh shot the booklet images. The US release followed on 14 September 1993. About Dead Can Dance Dead Can Dance formed in Melbourne in August 1981 as a trio, with Brendan Perry on vocals and guitar, Paul Erikson on bass and Simon Monroe on drums. Lisa Gerrard, previously of Microfilm, joined on vocals and percussion. Perry and Gerrard had met through Melbourne’s Little Band scene. Their first official recording, a home version of “Fatal Impact”, appeared on the December 1981 issue of the cassette magazine Fast Forward. After a farewell show at St Kilda’s Crystal Ballroom in May 1982 the pair moved to London and signed to 4AD, with Erikson and Peter Ulrich completing the first UK line-up. The self-titled debut arrived in February 1984, its sleeve built around a New Guinea ritual mask, and sat close to the ethereal wave of labelmates Cocteau Twins. The EP “Garden of the Arcane Delights” followed in August. From “Spleen and Ideal” (November 1985), co-produced with John A. Rivers and scored for cello, trombone and timpani, the duo turned towards the medieval and Renaissance material that became their signature; the album reached number 2 on the UK indie chart. Dead Can Dance’s ‘Within the Realm of a Dying Sun’ came in 1987, “The Serpent’s Egg” in 1988 and “Aion” in 1990, before “Into the Labyrinth” brought the ethnic instrumentation to the front of the arrangements. A world tour in 1994 produced the live album and film “Toward the Within”, recorded in California. Gerrard issued her solo debut “The Mirror Pool” in 1995, then reunited with Perry for “Spiritchaser” in 1996, which topped Billboard’s Top World Music Albums chart. Sessions for a follow-up broke down in 1998 and the duo separated, with one track from those tapes, “The Lotus Eaters”, surfacing on the box set “Dead Can Dance (1981-1998)” and on “Wake” in 2003. Gerrard recorded “Duality” with Pieter Bourke; Perry released “Eye of the Hunter” in 1999. They reunited for a 2005 European and North American tour, documented across a series of limited live releases, then returned to the studio for Dead Can Dance’s ‘Anastasis’ on 13 August 2012. Perry sold the Quivvy Church studio in 2015. “Dionysus”, mastered at Abbey Road, followed on 2 November 2018, and the duo toured Europe in 2022. In 2025 Perry said he was working on a sequel called “Apollo”, with himself as the only musician. New material has since appeared on Bandcamp through the band’s own Holy Tongue Records: “Our Day Will Come” on 20 March 2026, “Death Cults” in April, and Dead Can Dance release ‘The Cicadas’ single via Bandcamp in July. Thirty-three years on, “Into the Labyrinth” remains the record that took the duo from the 4AD roster to the Billboard 200.
items._cn_summary: Dead Can Dance的《Into the Labyrinth》于1993年由4AD发行，是二人首张无客座乐手参与的录音室专辑。Lisa Gerrard与Brendan Perry在分居两地的情况下各自创作，随后在爱尔兰Cavan郡的Quivvy教堂录音室合并录制。两位成员包揽所有器乐演奏，包括邦戈鼓、西塔琴与塔布拉鼓，呈现出跨文化的器乐融合特征。Gerrard在多首曲目中使用无歌词人声技法，两首为纯人声无伴奏演绎。专辑收录一首改编自18世纪爱尔兰民谣的作品，以及一首以Brecht诗作为词、配以原创音乐的曲目，后者是Brecht遗产委员会第二次授权此类改编。整体制作强调空间感与仪式性氛围，融合了中世纪音乐元素、世界音乐节奏与暗潮基调，展现了二人对多元文化声音的整合能力。

items.body: Krimea is an Italian duo formed in 2021 by Alice Taylor and Nick SoLow. Over the past few months, they have released three singles, all of which are included on this debut album. “Are You Human?” features 12 tracks largely inspired by relationships. From the very first notes, you can recognize the Electro-Pop influence that drives the duo. What also stands out immediately is the quality of the production and mixing. Krimea has clearly invested considerable time and expertise in creating a polished, high-quality record. The songs themselves are powerful Electro-Pop, yet they also possess a cold, atmospheric quality, incorporating vintage sounds and effects such as sweeps. Two songs are featuring guitar play. Certain sounds occasionally remind me of Kraftwerk, although this influence has clearly been transformed into a style and vibe that is uniquely their own. The vocal production is excellent, featuring a charismatic male voice alongside a warmer, ethereal female voice. She often provides backing vocals but occasionally steps forward for genuine duets. This is an interesting debut featuring several strong tracks. I look forward to hearing more from this duo, which, in my opinion, is clearly ready for a record deal. (Rating:7½). Listen to “Die-Monds”: “Die – monds” by Krimea About Krimea Krimea is an electro-pop duo from Venice, Italy, formed in 2021 by Alice Taylor and Nick SoLow. “Are You Human?”, released 10 April 2026, is the duo’s debut album, gathering twelve tracks written by Krimea and produced and mastered by William Benedetti. Guitar on “This Pleasure” and “Vivre le sombre” was played by Cosimo Mitrugno, with artwork photography by Matteo Bosi, per the band’s own Bandcamp credits. The album follows three singles issued ahead of release: “This Pleasure,” “Die-Monds” and “Over and Over,” all included on the final tracklist alongside nine additional songs. Bandcamp’s own album notes describe “Die-Monds” as built around the wordplay of “die” and “monds” (diamonds), with Alice Taylor crediting a vintage Poly800 II synthesizer for the track’s melodic range. No prior Side-Line coverage of Krimea has been found.
items._cn_summary: 意大利双人组合Krimea的首张专辑收录了此前发行的三首单曲，主题围绕人际关系展开。整张作品以电子流行风格为主轴，制作和混音质量获得乐评肯定，音色兼具力量感与冷峻氛围，融入了复古合成器音色和扫频效果，隐约可感Kraftwerk的影响但已转化为独特的个人风格。男声充满魅力，女声温暖空灵，常以和声形式出现，间或主导对唱。专辑在两首曲目中加入了吉他演奏，由客座乐手完成。整体而言，这是一张制作精良的电子流行作品，旋律抓耳、结构完整，但风格上偏向主流电子流行范畴，在实验性与先锋性方面探索有限，尚未展现出对声音设计或类型边界的突破意识。作为出道专辑展现了扎实的制作功底和成熟的合作默契，但距离形成高度个人化的艺术语汇仍有成长空间。

items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以墨西哥牛仔与夏威夷牧场文化的历史联系为线索，将西班牙语、夏威夷语和英语歌曲交织在一起。十六首曲目涵盖古老的夏威夷歌曲配以新的西班牙语歌词、墨西哥民歌配以新的夏威夷语歌词，以及原创作品和传统美国民谣。制作上以尤克里里、吉他、墨西哥竖琴和手风琴的密集编曲为骨架，在加州圣巴勃罗的录音室中以同期一室录音为主，保留了即兴的真实感。Taj Mahal和David Hidalgo作为特邀艺术家提供了丰富的音乐重量，参与选曲、编曲并演奏多种乐器，多位夏威夷本地歌手和乐队成员也贡献了各自的声线。专辑不仅是一次音乐上的跨文化对话，也融合了伍迪·格思里的移民工人主题作品，带有社会评论色彩。整体展现了多元语言、文化、年龄和性别合作的精神。

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?

items._cn_summary: 这是丹麦三人组GuldGanger的首张数字EP，五首作品以传统北欧民谣为主轴，仅含一首原创曲目。主唱Mia Guldhammer嗓音富有说服力，成为整张作品的核心支点。编曲中融入了口簧、风笛、扬琴、长笛与弦乐等乐器，营造出古老而略带粗粝的氛围。扬琴为传统曲目《Agnete Of Bjergmanden》铺设了精致的织体背景，口簧与弦乐在最后一首纯器乐曲中交织出充满弹性的张力。作为北欧民间音乐场景的入门作品，展现了乐队超出新人水准的成熟度，但尚未展现更强的实验性或个人风格突破。

items.body: Review by alainPP — Last Knight is a musical project established in 1997 by Jose Medina, featuring musicians such as Marc Atkinson (Riversea, Moon Halo), Mariano Gardella, Deibys Artigas, Rafael Pacha (guitars, also with The Samurai of Prog), and Troy Donockley (Nightwish)."The Grand Overture" is a cinematic musical narrative blending classical, folk, and medieval elements?a monumental opening piece with interwoven textures. "In the Middle Ages" navigates between Alan Parsons and the Beatles, featuring a captivating melody sung theatrically by Mariano, accompanied by Sacha's poignant, arpeggiated guitar work that evokes a harsh era. "The Kingdom of Asturias" is an acoustic instrumental reflecting rugged times, with a recorder ushering the listener into a Christian kingdom on the defensive. "A War of Eight Centuries" is an anthemic, chilling interlude with Marc narrating eight centuries of conflict. "Cordoba" features Sacha's arpeggios?recalling a time when beauty and art contended with war?and vibrant Andalusian guitar. On "War," Deibys sings a tune reminiscent of Rainbow, while vintage keyboards evoke Ayreon; Nelson delivers an 80s-style guitar solo that captures the chaos. "Chivalry Tales" is an interlude driven by percussive bass and Hammond organ, with piano flourishes that skip along like knights in battle. "A Green Field of Memories" is a somber ballad, a medieval-style piece humming with acoustic notes."The Kingdom of Leon" serves as a symphonic instrumental sequel?a sweeping epic in the vein of The Samurai of Prog and Alan Parsons. It features spellbinding keyboards, Troy's bagpipes, violins, and various flutes that conjure up the world of *Lord of the Rings*, elves, and imagined medieval tales. The organ engages in a playful duel with the guitar, while the drums drive the entertaining progressive soundscape; a notable mid-song break sees the bass aggressively challenge the organ in a moment that feels simultaneously Floyd-esque, Western, and cinematic. Note the finale, where the Andalusian influence revisits the "Spaghetti Western" atmosphere to create something truly divine. "Flames Would Rise"?referencing the flames meant for heretics?features a scorching vocal performance that sends shivers down the spine. "Across the Mountains" serves as an interlude that traverses the Pyrenees on the wings of a flute melody. "The Kingdom of Galicia" offers a second epic tableau, blending folk, jazz, and world music vibes; it features a hushed, atmospheric sound reminiscent of Unitopia, balanced by Oldfield-esque Celtic moods and hurdy-gurdy and mandolin played by Sacha. There is room for furious heavy guitar work and a cinematic melting pot narrated by Mariano, acting as the resident bard. Mellotron adds a sentimental medieval touch, leading into a distinctive outro. "Pamplona" is a baroque harpsichord interlude that captures an elegiac splendor. "The Backyard" is a pastoral sketch for flute and acoustic guitar, paving the way for a cinematic finale. Finally, "Hymn for Asturias" features Deibys singing of the cycle's end?a prayerful lament that nonetheless exudes hope, underscored by Troy's flute.Last Knight?a tale of medieval glory; rest assured, this first saga will captivate you, marking the beginning of a trilogy. It is a concept of cathedral-like proportions, blending symphonic prog with exhilarating cinematic folk. A perfect example of the genre.

items.body: Band: Mastodon | Album: Marrow Deep | Genre: Progressive metal | Year: 2026 From: Atlanta, USA | Label: Loma Vista Bandcamp Mastodon is a trailblazing band in the realm of modern metal. As it stands, prog-sludge is one of the most popular varieties of progressive metal, at least by the sheer number of bands playing in that style, and much of that popularity can surely be attributed to these Atlantans. In revisiting their discography prior to writing this review, I noticed something of a parallel to Metallica’s career trajectory. Both bands started off with four absolutely stunning albums. This phase of work was then followed by a shift toward more radio-friendly sounds. (Obviously, The Hunter was nowhere near the success that Metallica’s self-titled was, but there are still overarching similarities.) Metallica’s subsequent records have ranged from middling (Death Magnetic, Hardwired), to awful (Reload, St. Anger), to downright baffling (Lulu). Mastodon, meanwhile, has been more consistent (and simply better, to be frank), but their output since the masterpiece that is Crack the Skye has oscillated boring-to-okay. Marrow Deep, the group’s ninth LP, comes at a time of major change for the band. It follows five years after their last album, the perfectly fine but overlong Hushed & Grim. It’s also their first release since the death of guitarist-vocalist Brent Hinds, following his messy firing from the band. Longtime touring keyboardist João Nogueira has also joined the band, officially making Mastodon a quintet, alongside new guitarist Nick Johnston. The album opens with “Barbarians Blood”, where twisting guitar lines lead a stomping rhythm in its opening moments. There are more restrained passages, where guitars skitter about and keyboards add an eerie atmosphere. Additional flavors are drawn from sources as disparate as punk and jazz. Troy Sanders and Brann Dailor trade lead vocals, but this song gels beautifully. “Poisonous Weapons” continues on in a similar vein, with perhaps a more psychedelic atmosphere. I love the integration of keys into Mastodon’s sound. It makes everything feel so lush and rich. Not that they necessarily struggled on that front previously, but it’s an exciting new variation. Contrasts in tempo and intensity continue on “Your Ghost Again”. Brann’s vocals, in particular, soar and feel majestic atop the swirling instrumental backdrop. “Snakes for Dinner” calls back to Mastodon’s earliest releases with its raw energy and powerful groove, while the soaring chorus pulls in their best moments from albums like Once More Round the Sun. The synth solo is a ton of fun, too, and it’s exciting to hear keys play more than a supporting role for this band. “Out Like a Lamb” has a more restrained opening. It’s not a gentle song, but the riffs are more controlled, and the drumming is more tight than propulsive. Keyboard embellishments add some fun texture, and in the moments where the band does let loose, twangy clean guitar notes cut through for some fun, subtle contrast. By its end, this song begins feeling a little long, despite all its good qualities. Clean guitar and tinkling synths provide a mellow and rather pretty opening to “In the Ruins”. Even when the distorted guitar comes in, it’s more scratchy than blistering, lending a certain antique rustiness that fits the title well.That is, at least until guitars like machine guns burst in and the song launches off at a gallop. Despite having a lot of good elements, this song doesn’t quite come together in the same way as the preceding cuts. It’s all solid music, but things here just don’t quite fit together. The opening of “They’re Coming for You” features some of the clearest classic prog influence on the record. Speedy, technical instrumental lines swirl around each other, and the combination of metal with organ and electric piano remind me of some of Opeth’s work. In fact, this is a very Opeth-y song overall, with its gothic-tinged verses and gentle moments of contrast. It’s around this point in the album that things started running together a bit for me. “Golden Spires” is a solid cut, if not exactly distinct in the context of the record. “Moth and Bone” has a lovely gentle intro, with a more typically Mastodon-y second half. And “A Vampire’s Demeanor” is fairly straightforward, featuring some spookier, Opeth-y elements. None of these songs are bad, but they’re not exactly essential, either. Marrow Deep ends on its two longest songs. “The Vanishing” begins as a quiet, restrained composition. Effects-laden vocals, wiry guitars, and enveloping keyboard tones evoke a dreamy atmosphere. The song’s climax is a powerful passage, with passionate screams and blistering guitar. The album then ends with “The Three Fates”. Mastodon incorporates some alt-rock influence on this cut, especially in the vocal melodies. The midsection features narration over an ominous backing, and it’s mostly a success. Narration is tough to pull off well, but the end result here isn’t too distracting. What is distracting, though, is the jazzy instrumental noodling that follows. A bit of indulgence would have been fine, but this particular passage absolutely overstayed its welcome. Once they ditch the jazz, though, the song ends on a strong instrumental jam. Marrow Deep is Mastodon’s best record since Crack the Skye. The riffs are energetic and vital, with a lot of power and urgency behind them. The addition of a keyboardist has brought new depth to their sound, and the compositions are overall quite strong. It’s not a perfect record, mind you. It is longer than it needs to be, and the band could have taken a scalpel to some of the second half. Despite these gripes, I like what I hear, and it’s good to hear Mastodon back in peak form. Score: 80/100
items._cn_summary: Mastodon 2026年第九张专辑《Marrow Deep》在前吉他手Brent Hinds离世后，由新成员Nick Johnston和键盘手João Nogueira加入，乐队扩展为五人阵容。专辑延续了prog-sludge路线，融合了朋克、爵士与迷幻元素，键盘的融入成为新亮点。乐评指出乐队前四张专辑堪称杰作，自《Crack the Skye》之后作品质量参差不齐，新作在节奏与强度对比上有所探索，但文章在曲目讨论中途中断，信息有限。从风格定位看，该专辑属于前卫金属范畴，虽然融入了部分实验元素，但整体仍以传统重金属为基础框架，与用户偏好的实验前卫、爵士即兴、电子及暗潮等方向差距明显。厂牌Loma Vista具有主流背景，进一步降低了对此类偏好的契合度。

items.body: Label: Shift Paradigm Records, 2026 Personnel - Zeju Zheng: guitar; Arnie Sainz: piano; Drew Gress: bass; Chidiebere Emmanuel: drums. Emerging guitarist Zeju Zheng is based in New York, the city he relocated to in order to pursue a Master's Degree in Jazz Performance at New York University. Zheng, who studied under Peter Bernstein and Adam Rogers, releases his debut album, A Mind in Motion , which features six original compositions exploring themes of transition, memory, hope, and discovery. The pieces, written and recorded during Zheng's early years in New York, are performed by a quartet featuring pianist Arnie Sainz, seasoned bassist Drew Gress, and Nigerian-born drummer Chidiebere Emmanuel. " 53 " is pure post-bop sophistication in 5/4, spreading fragments of Miles and Shorter's ESP years. Invigorating tonal and rhythmic shifts, a straightforward swinging drive, and expressively patterned and articulated solos from Zheng and Sainz make this an exciting opener. “ Simple ", whose 6/8 feel creates an exciting spark, emerged from Zheng's studies with eclectic guitarist Brad Shepik. His influence transpires in the guitarist's busy yet precise solo. Before that, Sainz excels in phrasing and mood, likely spurred by Gress's decisive bass figure at the bottom. Guitar and piano unisons revisit the theme, providing a tidy resolution. Zheng showcases a balladic side on tunes like " Drain ", whose sense of calmness inspires a notable solo from Gress, and " At The Corner ", where the band plunges into a meditative melodic languor offered with a rich, rounded quality. The mellow tone speaks directly to the album's themes, and in both pieces, Gress and Emmanuel fulfill their foundational roles with trust. Far from casting us in a dimmer light are the two final tracks: the nicely tempered " Little Song ", and the harmonically rich " Waiting For You To Be Home ", which frees the emotions while finding comfort in hope and light. Rooted in tradition yet incorporating charismatic contemporary elements, the pieces in A Mind in Motion are rendered with lithe and spry interplay. Zheng is confirmed as a name to watch in the future. Favorite Tracks: 01 - “53" ► 03 - Simple ► 06 - Waiting For You To Be Home

items.body: Review by Alxrm — The beginning of the real Rush - no offense to John Rutsey and the debut album which I really like- but Geddy and Alex ever since were aspiring for a deeper sound and a more progressive direction which didn't appeal to John. This is made plain even from the intro of the opener of the album which actually was the jamming they did together when Neil was auditioning for the band. Even though the music remains essentially rock and most song durations are around the three-minute mark, the first twists and turns make the presence felt. More than that, acoustic (Fly by Night, In the End) and classical (Rivendell) guitars are tastefully used to widen their palette of sound. However, the key-track on the album is the suite By-Tor & The Snow Dog because its complex structure would become their compass for the future where they would go off their pure rock roots entirely.Compared to the debut, the listener can easily perceive the growth the band underwent within such a short amount of time. The unstrained enthousiasm is replaced by deeper and at times more complex compositions showing clearly that the boys would not content themselves by repetition. Moreover, the new guy would become their standard lyricist and would go down in history as one of the best of all time. We should thank our luck that their paths were crossed.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑标志着乐队从硬摇滚向更深层前卫方向转型的起点。新鼓手兼词作者的加入为乐队注入了更复杂的作曲理念，告别了首张专辑中较为直白的摇滚表达。专辑中木吉他的运用拓展了声音色彩，古典吉他段落增添了内省气质。然而，尽管《By-Tor & The Snow Dog》展现了乐队未来发展的方向——复杂结构和叙事性编曲——整张专辑的曲目大多仍维持在三分半左右的常规摇滚时长，前卫元素尚处于萌芽阶段。评论指出乐队在此阶段不愿重复自身，展现出明确的成长意愿，但相比后续作品中更为彻底的实验性探索，这张专辑仍处于过渡期。评论本身信息量适中，对转型节点的分析具有一定参考价值。

items.body: Review by A Crimson Mellotron — This might be the first time I have not been taken aback by a new Mastodon album, simply because theexpectations have been exceedingly high this time around. A reflection upon the dramatic passing offounding member Brent Hinds, following his departure from the band earlier, 'Marrow Deep' is arecord exploring grief through a variety of dense and ominous sounds. This is not necessarily areturn to the extreme and primal energy that had shaped the Atlanta-based band's early records, butit comes close to being their most straightforward metal album in years. Having added touringguitarist Nick Johnston and keyboardist Jo�o Nogueira to the lineup, this five-piece version ofMastodon is intriguing, but it lacks the untamed songwriting of Brent Hinds and his overtlypsychedelic undercurrents. For this reason, 'Marrow Deep' is somewhat less adventurous thanpreceding releases from the band, even if it preserves the sludge-informed prog metal framework thatlisteners have become accustomed to. It just feels solid all throughout but without significantpeaks.Production-wise, this album is strong but not groundbreaking, with the heavy guitars occupying mostof the mix. I do, however, vastly enjoy the prominent contributions of the band's full-time keyboardplayer, whose playing provides a beautiful atmospheric backdrop to the otherwise ravaging guitars ofBill Kelliher and Nick Johnston. Interestingly enough, there is a greater highlight on melodictextures and sombre passages on 'Marrow Deep', that had only been superficially explored on 'Hushedand Grim'. Nevertheless, this new Mastodon record feels meandering without really having any weakmoments. Highlight tracks like the fast-paced 'Snakes for Dinner', the ritualistic sludgy number'They're Coming for You', and the tasteful but melancholic song 'The Vanishing', featuring GeezerButler and reminiscent of the great 'Planet Caravan', are perhaps the only moments worth lookingforward to upon repeated listens, while monotonous heavy numbers like 'Poisonous Weapons' and 'Inthe Ruins' lack the novel and mind-bending edge that used to make each new Mastodon something toanticipate.Longtime fans of the band will discover heaps of excellent, wild and turbulent riffs here, while theenjoyers of the band's progressive leanings shall be pleased with the haunting keyboards appearingon 'Marrow Deep'. Consistent and straightforward, this record hardly reinvents the Mastodon sound,which is very likely why it doesn't fully click with me.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是Mastodon在创始成员Brent Hinds离队后推出的新作，以沉重阴郁的音色调性探索哀痛主题。乐队在保留泥浆金属框架的基础上融入了更突出的键盘氛围铺底，吉他音墙占据混音主导地位。整体编曲扎实稳定，但在冒险精神和创新性上有所收敛，缺乏过往作品中那种野性十足的精神气质。部分曲目呈现仪式化的暗黑旋律和怀旧抒情段落，部分曲目则陷入单调重复的沉重套路。评论者认为专辑虽无明显弱点却也缺少真正的高光时刻，难以在反复聆听中持续提供新鲜感。

items.body: Italian gothic rock, post-punk and darkwave quartet Christine Plays Viola kick off a Spain and UK tour on 11 September 2026, opening in Barcelona before three nights in Spain and four shows across the United Kingdom through 20 September. The run follows the band’s 2026 album “F.I.V.E. (Fear Increases Violent Emotions)” and its singles. Ticket arrangements are handled by the individual venues; the 18 September Shropshire show is confirmed as free entry. The Spanish leg runs Barcelona, Madrid and Valencia with local support acts each night. In the UK, Christine Plays Viola play London, Shropshire, Morecambe and Gateshead, including a slot at the Bats in the Attic Festival in Morecambe. Tour dates for Christine Plays Viola 11 September – Barcelona, Spain – Sala Freedonia, with Darklands 12 September – Madrid, Spain – Cadavra, with Last Dusk 13 September – Valencia, Spain – Black Note Club, with After Mankind 17 September – London, UK – The Hope & Anchor, with Long Night and Last Dusk 18 September – Shropshire, UK – Percy’s Café Bar, with DJ SyncroMystic (free entry) 19 September – Morecambe, UK – Alhambra Live, Bats in the Attic Festival 20 September – Gateshead, UK – The Black Bull, with The Exceptional Mr Hyde About Christine Plays Viola Christine Plays Viola formed in 2008 in Abruzzo, Italy, around an idea by guitarist Fabrizio Giampietro and drummer Daniele Palombizio, joined shortly after by bassist Desio Presutti and a singer known as Christian. The band released its debut album, “Innocent Awareness”, in 2011, followed in 2014 by “Vacua”, a record inspired by Spanish painter Francisco de Goya that anchored the group in the darkwave and new wave scene. The current lineup features Giampietro on guitars, synth and programming, Massimo Ciampani on vocals, Gianluca Orsini on drums and Marco Di Ianni on bass. The band’s fifth studio album, “F.I.V.E. (Fear Increases Violent Emotions)”, was released on 19 January 2026 through Cleopatra Records. Christine Plays Viola supported the album with the single “Desolate Moments” in April 2026 and the standalone track “At Last, I Found You” in July 2026. The Spain and UK dates mark the band’s first live run since those releases.

items.body: Australian industrial synth crust artist Schkeuditzer Kreuz, the solo project of Kieren Hills, returns to Japan and Southeast Asia in October 2026 for a 21-date run across seven countries in 24 days: Japan, Cambodia, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines. Ticket details are handled by the individual venues and promoters; several Southeast Asian stops are listed with the venue still to be announced. The tour opens in Tokyo on 2 October and works through Nagoya, Shizuoka and Osaka before crossing into Cambodia, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, closing in Dasmariñas, Cavite, on 22 October, with three further Indonesian dates following on 23 to 25 October. Stops include the Visayas Hardcore Punk Fest in Bacolod City and a Bali date at Gimme Shelter. Tour dates for Schkeuditzer Kreuz 2 October – Tokyo, Japan – Earthdom 3 October – Tokyo, Japan – Ochiai 4 October – Nagoya, Japan – Duct 6 October – Shizuoka, Japan – Sougen 7 October – Osaka, Japan – Hokage 8 October – Siem Reap, Cambodia – Atlantis Metal Bar 9 October – Phnom Penh, Cambodia – Distortion 10 October – Chiang Mai, Thailand – Yoda Gallery 13 October – Bangkok, Thailand – Live Haus BKK 14 October – Singapore – venue to be announced 15 October – Batam, Indonesia – Loka Suara 16 October – Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia – Moutou 17 October – Bacolod City, Philippines – Visayas Hardcore Punk Fest 18 October – General Santos City, Philippines – venue to be announced 19 October – Davao City, Philippines – venue to be announced 20 October – Cebu City, Philippines – venue to be announced 21 October – Quezon City, Philippines – venue to be announced 22 October – Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines – venue to be announced 23 October – Bali, Indonesia – Gimme Shelter 24 October – Jogjakarta, Indonesia – venue to be announced 25 October – Purworejo, Indonesia – venue to be announced About Schkeuditzer Kreuz Schkeuditzer Kreuz is the solo project of Kieren Hills, who was born in New Zealand and is based in Lawson, in the Blue Mountains of New South Wales, Australia. The project combines electronic body music and industrial with crust and d-beat punk, a sound Hills has described with terms such as “industrial synth crust” and “d-beat raw synth punk”. The debut release was the five-song 12-inch EP “Give Me Nothing”, launched with a 15-date tour across eastern Australia in March 2021. The discography includes the albums “Isolated and Alone” (2021) and “No Life Left” (2023), the latter later repressed on Bad Habit Records. Schkeuditzer Kreuz first toured Japan in June 2024, a run Side-Line covered at the time. In November 2024 the project released a split 7-inch with Decide Today, and the following year issued the split EP “State Violence State Control” with Sydney act Low Life on Winter Garden Records. The third album, “Swan Grinder“, mastered by Martin Bowes of Attrition, followed on 30 August 2025 and was supported by a European tour that September and October. The single “Keep Dancing”, a remix from “Swan Grinder”, was released in June 2026. The October 2026 dates return Schkeuditzer Kreuz to Japan and Southeast Asia with the widest regional spread of the “Swan Grinder” campaign, adding Cambodia, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines to the itinerary alongside Japan.

items.body: The March Violets reissue “Turn to the Sky” b/w “Miss Amanda Jones” on digital services on September 18, 2026, and have added a second run of tour dates across the UK, continental Europe and Brazil. The English post-punk and gothic rock band released “Turn to the Sky” as a single in February 1986 on London Records, and the version now being reissued is the re-recording made the following year for the John Hughes film “Some Kind of Wonderful.” The reissue pairs that 1987 film version of “Turn to the Sky” with “Miss Amanda Jones,” a cover of the Rolling Stones song that the band recorded for the same soundtrack. Both tracks had previously been available only on the film’s soundtrack album. Producer Stephen Hague, working from the band’s 1986 original, re-recorded “Turn to the Sky” for the film, and the band performed the song on screen, spending two weeks on the production’s Hollywood set. “Some Kind of Wonderful,” directed by Howard Deutch and written and produced by John Hughes as a follow-up to his 1986 hit “Pretty in Pink,” stars Lea Thompson as Amanda Jones, the character the film’s title track and the Rolling Stones cover both reference. The tour, billed as the second leg of the “Unnatural History” run, follows 14 UK dates the band played in June and July 2026 in support of their “Natural History” album reissue. Alongside that 1980s catalogue, the band also performs songs from Crocodile Promises, their 2024 album, and have said a further album is half-finished. Tour dates for The March Violets October 27, 2026 – Prague, Czechia – Lucerna Music Bar October 31, 2026 – Whitby, UK – Tomorrow’s Ghosts Festival, Pavilion Theatre November 1, 2026 – Newcastle-upon-Tyne, UK – The Cluny November 3, 2026 – Edinburgh, UK – Speakeasy November 5, 2026 – Derby, UK – The Hairy Dog November 6, 2026 – Huddersfield, UK – Amped November 8, 2026 – Bedford, UK – Esquires November 10, 2026 – London, UK – New Cross Inn November 11, 2026 – Brighton, UK – Komedia February 6, 2027 – Sao Paulo, Brazil – Wave Festival Ticket and merchandise links for the dates are listed on the band’s official site. About The March Violets The March Violets formed in Leeds in December 1981, when guitarist Tom Ashton, bassist Laurence “Loz” Elliott, and singers Simon “Detroit” Denbigh and Rosie Garland met at Leeds University. Sisters of Mercy singer Andrew Eldritch released the band’s debut EP, “Religious as Hell,” on his Merciful Release label on August 28, 1982. Seven March Violets singles reached the UK Indie Chart, and the 1984 compilation “Natural History” reached number three on that chart. Cleo Murray replaced Garland as the band’s main vocalist from the 1983 single “Snakedance” onward. In 1986 the band signed to the major label London Records and released “Turn to the Sky,” written by Murray, Elliott and Ashton, as its final single before splitting. The band, by then made up of Ashton, Elliott, drummer Andy Tolson and Murray, went on to record and perform “Turn to the Sky” and “Miss Amanda Jones” for the 1987 film “Some Kind of Wonderful.” The band reunited in 2007 for a one-off Leeds show with Denbigh, Garland and Ashton, joined by Matt Thorpe (of Isolation Division) on bass, and reformed again in 2010. That lineup of Garland, Ashton and Thorpe released a five-CD boxset in 2022 and the album Crocodile Promises on Metropolis Records on July 19, 2024. The reissue of “Turn to the Sky” and “Miss Amanda Jones,” and the new tour dates announced alongside it, follow that album and this year’s “Natural History” reissue and its accompanying UK tour.

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. Find the artist online. Sara Serpa - Encounters and Collisions (Review) Karine Polwart- Laws of Motion (Review) Live in the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, 2025

items._cn_summary: 这是一张以人声与钢琴为核心的苏格兰民谣专辑，由歌手Karine Polwart与声音设计师Pippa Murphy合作完成，灵感源自爱丁堡皇家植物园一棵拥有两百年历史、2021年被砍伐的棕榈树。Dave Milligan的钢琴伴奏克制而细腻，与Polwart温暖的人声共同营造出亲密的聆听氛围。声音设计以轻巧的音景铺底，不喧宾夺主。歌词围绕树木、自然与时间的循环展开，反复出现的旋律片段如挽歌般在脑中驻留。从一棵树出发，专辑将个人记忆、历史叙事与自然沉思编织在一起，结尾揭示树种身份被重新鉴定，幼苗将继承前辈的位置，赋予这张作品新旧交替的隐喻。整体气质内敛沉思，适合偏好文本叙事与简约声学编制的听众。

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets

items._cn_summary: 这是一张以1819年英国彼得卢屠杀事件为主题的概念专辑，Sean Cooney以原创民谣歌曲回溯这一工人运动史上的关键时刻。专辑以书籍形式呈现，配以历史信件、政治漫画与插图，构成多媒体体验。音乐部分由小型乐团完成，包含吉他手Sam Carter、小提琴歌手Eliza Carthy、贝斯与乐器演奏者Ben Nicholls，以及兰开夏工业民谣歌手Jennifer Reid担任叙述者。歌曲捕捉了集会现场的期待与兴奋、骑兵冲入时的恐惧与奔逃，以及事后悲痛的余波，旋律有力，歌词意象精准。三重唱的人声编排是该专辑的亮点。作为一张历史题材的叙事民谣专辑，其制作精良、情感真挚，但音乐风格偏向传统英式民谣与工业民谣，缺乏实验性元素或跨界融合，与实验、前卫、电子等偏好类型的距离较远。

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑记录了Dr. John（Malcolm Rebennack Jr.）1999年在德国莱茵河畔洛雷莱露天剧场的演出。演出以新奥尔良狂欢节式的编排为核心，混合了新奥尔良经典曲目与个人代表作。乐队由吉他手Bobby Broom、贝斯手David Barard和鼓手Herman Ernest组成，节奏紧凑且充满权威感。开场曲选用经典的Iko Iko，将新奥尔良第二线游行传统带入现场，Qualified展现了自信张扬的一面，I Walk on Guilded Splinters则带有强烈的巫毒仪式感和迷幻放克色彩。专辑还收录了Sweet Home New Orleans、Goin' Back to New Orleans等怀乡之作以及对Duke Ellington的致敬，并以Earl King的Big Chief收尾。整场演出融合了新奥尔良传统、放克节奏与Dr. John标志性的神秘主义表演风格，是一份兼具档案价值与现场感染力的现场实录。

items.body: This new release sets Beethoven‘s Symphonies Nos. 5, 6 and 7 beside works by Cherubini, Spontini and Rossini, to reveal parallels and influences between the two. Enrico Onofri, a conductor new to me, leads the Münchener Kammerorchester with interpretive ideas that prove both thrilling and frustrating. Beethoven & the Italians Amazon Presto Apple The program opens with an exhilarating reading of Cherubini’s Médée Overture. Although the Munich Chamber Orchestra play on modern instruments, their bowing, articulation, use of open strings, and minimal string vibrato could lead listeners to mistake them for a period-instrument ensemble. It is likely that the brass are period instruments; the timpani are played with hard mallets and the winds are well to the fore, creating a far more heterogeneous palette of color than is heard in Marriner’s middle-of-the-road performance (Academy of St Martin in the Fields/Warner Classics). Munich’s incisive and dramatic playing is more compelling. The same cannot be said of Beethoven’s Fifth. Onofri all but ignores the fermatas in the opening bars, as well as the fermata for the first violins a few bars later. Throughout the first movement, rhythmic distortions and unusual articulation are used, perhaps to create more light and shade. But this music is built on incessant, unrelenting momentum; to work against that is to ignore its basic purpose. It also negates the intended moment of calm we are meant to feel during the oboe cadenza in the recapitulation. It should be the one point where everything stops and we experience a moment of tranquility, until the rest of the orchestra rudely dismisses the idea. Here the oboe makes a full meal of it, and Onofri inserts a long pause afterward, as if the orchestra were weighing the idea of peace: again, the opposite of Beethoven’s intent. The inner movements are better, because Onofri makes far fewer interpretive interventions. He does insert unmarked swells on long notes, something Norrington and Mackerras both embraced in their first Beethoven cycles (and did not return to in their second traversals). The Trio section of the Scherzo is brilliantly played, and I like how Onofri adds length and weight to the opening three chords of the finale, giving us the chance to really hear the new sonority of the added trombones and piccolo. The first movement’s interpretive manipulations mar an otherwise exciting performance. The first movement of Beethoven’s Sixth feels fast (10’50”), though it falls within the range of several recent performances: Immerseel/Anima Eterna on Zig-Zag Territoires (10’37”), Krivine/La Chambre Philharmonique on Naïve (10’53”) and Honeck/Pittsburgh on Reference Recordings (11’01” – review). But each of these earlier readings features greater flexibility of pulse and less aggressive playing, whereas Onofri seems ruthlessly efficient. Beethoven – Symphony No. 5 – A Beginners Guide The Scene by the Brook is shaped with care, with subtle rubato and soft playing of real delicacy, but there are moments, when the violins have the melody, where one struggles to hear it in the overall texture. The Munich string section is small (the booklet lists 6/5/4/5/2 for the Pastoral), even compared to other historically informed performances: Savall uses 10/8/6/5/3 (review) and Gardiner (Symphonies 5 and 7/SDG) uses 12/10/8/6/4. Throughout the program, the strings lack the presence and power they need. The stomping energy of the Scherzo feels particularly folksy (listen out for the surprise towards the end of the movement), but the storm is curiously slow, lacking the drive and vivid pictorialism that is so often a highlight of historically informed performances. The Shepherds’ Song finale is joyous, though the braying horns and undernourished strings rob the music of any spiritual ecstasy. Beethoven’s Seventh receives the most successful performance, because Onofri offers far fewer interpretive ideas. By this point, though, the string problem felt omnipresent, a continual distraction from full engagement with the playing. And then there are “the other Italians.” Spontini’s Olimpie Overture follows the Fifth, its three-chord opening an immediate connection to the finale of the symphony. It is played with technical brilliance and arresting vitality. Onofri, to his credit, rejects treating Rossini’s Guillaume Tell Overture as “pops” music; instead, he highlights its originality and symphonic dimensions. The opening is played with real tenderness, and the trombones are impressive in the storm, but once again the strings lack presence. The final work is Cherubini’s Symphony in D major, in a performance more convincing and better played than Bellugi’s reading (Sanremo Symphony Orchestra/Naxos) or Chailly’s La Scala album (Decca). Onofri’s reading is significantly slower than both, and that extra time allows for lovely lyrical moments. The program does draw out some parallels between the compositions, but not to any revelatory degree. I would return to this recording for the performances of the Italian repertoire.
